text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zimbabwe press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- One of Zimbabwe's leading conglomerates, Meikles Consolidated Holdings, is expected to come on the Zimbabwe Stock exchange to raise Z$300 million for an expansion programme.
- The Zimbabwean capital Harare's town clerk Edward Kanengoni has been accused of complicity in delaying a proposed multi-purpose development worth millions of dollars in one of the city's suburbs .
- Some Zimbabwean civil servants suspected of having taken part in a recent strike for salary increments have had their posts frozen and are being retired within a month.
- Zimbabwe and Iran on Thursday signed 12 agreements to enhance trade and co-operation in communication, construction, agriculture and transport.

- Zimbabwean vice-president Simon Muzenda on Thursday received donations worth about Z$4 million in cash and kind towards the country's hosting of the World Solar Summit starting next week, bringing the total so far to about Z$20 million.
